providers.name: Learning Fresh — Mont Kiara
providers.address: LG3-6, Plaza Arcoris, Jalan Kiara, Mont Kiara, 50480 Kuala Lumpur
providers.wording: Hourly drop-in care is available without a package. Call ahead to check space. Weekday, weekend and evening sessions have different prices and times.
providers.question: Is there space for these hours, and which hourly rate applies?
providers.hoursNote: Childcare sessions: weekdays 13:00–18:30; weekends 09:00–17:00. Night Owl continues to 22:30 on weekdays and 21:00 on weekends. These specific care sessions differ from the general opening-hours panel. Call ahead.

fees.conditions: Monday–Friday 18:30–22:30; Saturday–Sunday 17:00–21:00. Confirm the visit before attending.

notes: The general school profile gives ages 3–12, while newer programme pages cover other ranges. Confirm the age range for the selected hourly session.
providers.identityReview: Provider care page names Mont Kiara; contact-page campus data gives the Plaza Arcoris address and coordinates. Its own Setmore page repeats the address, phone and specific hourly sessions. No matching name, address or phone was found in the base catalogue.

providers.wording: The After-School Club page names Damansara Heights and offers care by the hour, including occasional drop-offs. Call ahead for space and confirm weekend arrangements.
providers.question: Can you take a new child for these hours at the Damansara Heights campus?
providers.hoursNote: Hourly programme: weekdays 13:00–18:30 and weekends 09:00–17:00. The campus list on the same page says Monday–Saturday, so Sunday hours remain unconfirmed.

fees.conditions: Published weekend rate, 09:00–17:00. Confirm the campus and day; the location list says Monday–Saturday.

notes: The listed number is the provider's shared enquiry contact.
providers.identityReview: The hourly-care page explicitly names Plaza Damansara; provider contact-page campus data supplies its exact street address and coordinates. Shared phone matches the programme page. No matching branch found in base catalogue.

providers.name: iKid House — Bandar Puteri
providers.address: 11-1, Jalan Puteri 4/7a, Bandar Puteri, 47100 Puchong, Selangor
providers.wording: Occasional drop-in care is advertised. Families can choose days and hours as needed; ask about the minimum stay, notice and space for this visit.
providers.question: Can a new child stay for these hours, and how much notice do you need?
providers.identityReview: The provider's flexible-scheduling and enquiry pages give the same Bandar Puteri address and office phone. Its linked Google Maps pin matches iKid House. Not the unrelated iKids Cyberjaya entry in the base catalogue.

providers.name: Lullabee — Old Klang Road
providers.address: 3G & 3G-1, Wisma Ambawang, Jalan Anggor, Jalan Klang Lama, 58100 Kuala Lumpur
providers.wording: Hourly drop-in care is advertised at the Old Klang Road branch for short visits. Contact the centre before coming to confirm space, ages, minimum hours and the total fee.
providers.question: Is hourly care available at Old Klang Road for these hours, and what does the listed RM120 cover?
providers.hoursNote: Monday–Friday 07:30–19:00; weekends and public holidays closed. The published number is the shared Lullabee enquiry contact.

fees.conditions: The product page displays RM120 but does not state how many hours it covers. This is not a verified hourly rate; ask for the total for your visit.

notes: Public holidays are listed closed; confirm opening for the chosen date. The fee page does not specify the RM120 billing period.
providers.identityReview: The hourly product explicitly names Old Klang Road. Contact-page branch section supplies the Wisma Ambawang address, coordinates and hours. This is separate from the existing Puchong Taska Pondok Indah/Lullabee branch; no Old Klang Road address or name matches the base catalogue.

providers.name: Kinder Mindz — Kepong

providers.question: Can you take a child for just these hours, and what are the booking requirements?
providers.identityReview: Provider contact page and Google Maps agree on the exact ground-floor Block C address, phone and website. About page clearly states 1–12 years, resolving the contact-page age typo. No matching name, address or phone found in base catalogue.

providers.name: Kasih Nilly Nursery
providers.wording: The nursery's August 2026 public posts advertise hourly, one-day and weekly care. Contact the nursery to check space and the price for this visit.
providers.question: Can my child attend for these hours, and what is the minimum charge?
providers.hoursNote: Public nursery posts list Monday–Friday 07:30–18:30. Weekend arrangements are not stated.
notes: The listed address identifies the Warisan Cityview complex. Ask the nursery for the exact unit and entrance before visiting.
providers.identityReview: The nursery's public August 2026 posts link its Linktree, which links the Google Maps destination at Warisan Cityview. Name and phone match that map listing. Coordinates use the destination, not the start of its directions link. No matching base-catalogue branch was found.
